meta.title: KNOWLEDGE X — API & External Integration Architecture
meta.subtitle: In-Process Python Service Contracts, Gemini AI Gateway (Model Fallback & Vision OCR), Google OAuth 2.0 / OIDC & SSRF-Gated PDF Fetching

views.label: Gemini AI API
views.note: Structured JSON schemas, retries, daily exhaustion cache, model fallback, and multimodal OCR.

views.label: OAuth & Web PDF APIs
views.note: External identity endpoints and DNS/IP SSRF firewall guarding arbitrary user PDF URLs.

components.label: Streamlit Pages & App Shell
components.explanation: KNOWLEDGE X exposes no FastAPI/Flask REST endpoints; UI actions call typed Python APIs in modules/ directly inside the Streamlit server process.

components.label: Gemini Gateway Contract
components.explanation: Resolves GEMINI_API_KEY (override > .env > secrets.toml), runs test_gemini_connection(), tracks _DAILY_EXHAUSTED_MODELS, and steps down FALLBACK_MODELS on quota/rate-limit errors.

components.label: Multimodal Vision Contract
components.explanation: Resizes validated scan images to <=2000px and invokes Gemini structured JSON generation with raw image bytes to extract headings and transcribed prose.

components.label: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC Client
components.explanation: Builds S256 PKCE authorization URLs, exchanges ?code via requests.post, and verifies signed Google ID tokens with clock-skew checks and JWKS validation.

components.label: SSRF-Guarded URL Fetcher
components.explanation: Rejects credentials-in-URL, blocks localhost/metadata hostnames, resolves DNS to ensure public global IPv4/IPv6 (blocking RFC1918, loopback, link-local, NAT64), and validates each redirect hop up to 5 hops and 25MB.

components.label: Google Gemini GenerateContent API
components.explanation: Executes models.list() health checks and structured application/json generation bounded by Pydantic response_schema objects.

components.label: Google Gemini Multimodal Vision
components.sublabel: google-genai · Image Bytes + OCR Schema Prompt
components.explanation: Processes JPEG/PNG document scans alongside structured OCR prompts to return OCRPageExtraction payloads.

components.label: Google Authorization Endpoint
components.explanation: Presents Google consent screen with scope='openid email profile', S256 code_challenge, and CSRF state parameter.

components.label: Google OAuth Token Endpoint
components.explanation: Exchanges single-use authorization code + PKCE code_verifier + client credentials for Google OIDC id_token and access metadata.

components.label: Google OIDC Public JWKS
components.explanation: Verifies RS256 ID token signature, audience (GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID), issuer (accounts.google.com), non-empty sub, email, and email_verified=true.

components.label: External Public PDF Servers
components.explanation: Delivers downloadable research PDFs; non-PDF HTML payloads and unsafe redirects are rejected before disk storage.

boundaries.label: Internal Python API Layer (modules/ — No HTTP Listener)

cards.title: Why There Are No Custom REST Endpoints
items: All business capabilities are exposed as typed Python functions across 8 modules inside modules/ rather than a separate FastAPI/Flask microservice.
Streamlit communicates with the browser over its internal WebSocket/HTTP transport; only outbound HTTP(S) integrations leave the process.

cards.title: Gemini API Resilience & Quota Protection
items: Every structured AI call enforces REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS=90_000, retry_attempts=2, Pydantic schema validation, and JSON extraction fallback.
Daily quota exhaustion marks models in _DAILY_EXHAUSTED_MODELS for immediate skip, stepping down FALLBACK_MODELS automatically when auto_fallback is enabled.

cards.title: Outbound HTTP Guardrails
items: Google OAuth exchanges run over HTTPS POST with 15s timeout, strict PKCE S256, and verified OIDC claims before session minting.
Public PDF URL downloads resolve DNS and block private/loopback/link-local/reserved/NAT64 IPs on initial URL and all <=5 redirects.
